photos.name: crumb-shot
photos.summary: Cross-section of the loaf on a bamboo cutting board showing open, irregular crumb with a mix of small and medium holes throughout. Thin, well-browned crust.

photos.name: finished-loaf-closeup
photos.summary: Close-up of the finished loaf cooling on a round wire rack, showing the golden crust with flour dusting and a single score line down the center. Cookbooks and a blue crock visible in the background.

photos.name: finished-loaf-overhead
photos.summary: Overhead-angled view of the loaf on the wire cooling rack, showing the full round shape and even golden-brown color across the top crust with scattered flour.

photos.name: finished-loaf-quarter-alt
photos.summary: Three-quarter front view of the loaf on the cooling rack, showing good oven spring and the cross-score pattern opened up nicely. Dutch oven visible in the background.

photos.name: finished-loaf-quarter
photos.summary: Three-quarter view highlighting the ear from the score marks and the crisp, blistered crust texture. Loaf has a slightly oblong shape on the wire rack with the Dutch oven behind it.

photos.name: finished-loaf-side
photos.summary: Side profile of the loaf on the wire rack showing the score split open along the top. Gooseneck kettle and olive oil visible on the counter behind it.
